WITH nationality_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    c.nationality,
    SUM(cr.points) as total_points,
    COUNT(cr.constructorResultsId) as num_entries
  FROM constructorResults cr
  JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
  GROUP BY c.nationality
),
average_entries AS (
  SELECT AVG(num_entries) as avg_entries
  FROM nationality_stats
)
SELECT 
  ns.nationality,
  ns.total_points,
  ns.num_entries,
  ae.avg_entries,
  ns.num_entries - ae.avg_entries as difference_from_average
FROM nationality_stats ns
CROSS JOIN average_entries ae
ORDER BY ns.total_points DESC;
